items.question: Did Amber Harris play in the WNBA?
items.answer: Yes. The Minnesota Lynx drafted Amber Harris fourth overall in 2011 out of Xavier. She played five WNBA seasons, with Minnesota from 2011 to 2013 and the Chicago Sky in 2017 and 2018, averaging 2.7 points and 1.8 rebounds in 112 regular-season games. She won WNBA titles with the Lynx in 2011 and 2013.

items.question: Did Amber Harris play for the Chicago Sky?
items.answer: Yes. Amber Harris played 28 regular-season games for the Chicago Sky over the 2017 and 2018 seasons, averaging 1.5 points and 1.5 rebounds.

items.question: Where did Amber Harris play college basketball?
items.answer: Amber Harris played at Xavier from 2006 to 2011, with a redshirt year in 2008-09. She averaged 16.6 points and 9.2 rebounds over 133 games, was Atlantic 10 Player of the Year in 2010 and 2011, and was an AP second-team All-American in 2011.
